DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A or B.

The prolonged Partial Thromboplastin Time (PTT) of 60 seconds with a normal Prothrombin Time indicates a defect in the intrinsic coagulation pathway. Given your history of easy bruising and post-extraction bleeding, this strongly suggests Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency) or Hemophilia B (Factor IX deficiency).
